items.text: 哎——哟。那这些国家肯定挨得很近吧。
items.q: Maman reacts to news of earthquakes abroad. Does this sound like a mother from a small town?

items.text: 这是到了末世啦。比比那一代人总说，到了末世，大地就会一直摇晃。
items.q: Maman recalls what the old folks said about the end of days. Does it sound like her?

items.text: 嗯，我们怕你难过，娜娜·佩萨尔·江。你还有博士论文答辩。
items.q: Maman explains why they kept bad news from her son. Does this sound like her?

items.text: 嗯，这些人，她活着的时候也没给她做多少事。
items.q: Maman complains about her in-laws. Does this sound natural?

items.text: 嗯，你是去旅游散心的，当然好过了。辛苦的那面你没看见。
items.q: Maman teases her husband about his trip abroad. Does this sound like her?

items.text: 哎，每次说让他拿个东西，他就像触电一样。
items.q: Maman complains that her husband jumps whenever he is asked to fetch something. Does it sound like her?

items.text: 他就是找借口抱怨，呵，阿米尔·江。这个不行，就找别的。
items.q: Maman shrugs off her husband's complaints. Does this sound like her?

items.text: 哎，妮妮一下子困了。我从早上起来就一直没睡。
items.q: Maman, calling herself by her pet name Nini, pretends to be sleepy. Does this sound playful and natural?

items.text: 后来护士亲自过来说：“我看这位是跟你们一起来的吧。”
items.q: Maman retells what a nurse said at the hospital. Does this sound natural?
before: – 在医院，他们一直喊：“阿德罕女士的家属！”没有人动。

items.text: 我许了个愿，要是他好起来，我就步行去马什哈德。
items.q: Maman tells of a vow she made for her son. Does it sound like her?
before: 有几个月，我每天早晨睁开眼睛，看到的是伊朗，而不是丹麦。玛曼终于明白，除了博士的压力和焦虑，对一个姑娘的爱已经把我拖到了崩溃的悬崖边。我躺在房间的黑暗里，透过门缝看见卡塞姆坐在家里的客厅里、对着电视嗑瓜子，玛曼坐在他旁边。新闻在讲全国北部和西部各省大范围洪灾造成的损失。从背后看，玛曼在我眼里像一个小小的圆，挨着一个大些的长方形坐着。玛曼说：

items.q: Maman uses a Persian image, eating sorrow, for grieving in silence. Would a reader guess that from context?
before: – 没有。我就是个苦命人，什么都不说，一直闭着嘴。

items.text: 你做的事全是些糊弄了事的招。
items.q: During a quarrel, one parent snaps at the other about sloppy fixes. Does this sound natural?
before: – 好了，这样不行——一会儿为了上学把出生证明里姓氏中的“阿”撕掉，一会儿为了别的单位又粘回去。
– 这跟你有什么关系？我知道我在做什么。

items.text: 只要这根线在你手里，你就不会迷路。另一头在我手里。
items.q: Maman reassures her four-year-old son. Does it sound like a mother talking to a small child?

items.text: 什么东西让你害怕的时候，就用一个办法，这样你就不会害怕了。
items.q: Maman praises her small son's trick for not being scared. Does it sound like a mother talking to a child?

items.text: 这么大的浪是打哪儿来的？
items.q: Maman reacts to a huge wave the family is watching. Does this sound like her?

items.text: 那为什么，现在我站在小巷门后面，她不来找我哪怕一次呢？
items.q: A six-year-old tells this. Does it sound like a small child?
